description.value: The Blaylock Mansion is a 4.5-star historic estate set on 3 acres above Kootenay Lake near Nelson, BC, built around the legacy of mining magnate Selwyn Blaylock and featuring manicured tiered gardens, an outdoor pool, a private tennis court, and one of the largest arboretums in southern BC. It operates as a body-and-mind retreat and wedding venue with gourmet breakfast prepared each morning for guests. Touring cyclists passing through the Kootenays would find a genuinely scenic and distinctive stay within easy reach of Nelson's services.

The business appears operational based on an active booking system and COVID update, though recent blog posts are sparse.
